contentText:
Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” gets one step closer to tying Mariah Carey for the record for the longest running No. 1, Bruno Mars is back in the top 10 with “Risk It All,” with Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande, Olivia Dean and Morgan Wallen helping to round out the rest of the top 10.

This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Sept. 12. Still at 10 is “Be Her,” “Risk It All” is back in the top 10, “Man I Need” is up a spot. “So Easy” is locked at No. 7, so is “Dracula” at six, “Been By Now” slips to five, while Ariana rises to four. Taylor Swift stays at No. 3, as does Stella Lefty at two. Which means grabbing a 21st week at No. 1 is Ella Langley.
